environment.description: Ktor microservice deployed on ECS Fargate, connecting to Aurora PostgreSQL 14.9. Database connection uses role 'app_service' which has been granted full DML privileges (SELECT, INSERT, UPDATE, DELETE) on all tables in the 'public' schema via: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_service. No query-level firewall or SQL proxy in the connection path. Environment variable DATABASE_USER=app_service.

config.db_permissions: GRANT ALL ON ALL TABLES IN SCHEMA public TO app_service
config.network: Direct VPC connectivity, no SQL proxy
